verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is an AI-driven game engine with hosted services (servers, player saves, analytics), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, opt-out controls, or a privacy policy on model training. The MCP, CLI, publishing and analytics material is off-topic for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
